We have also clarified that neither party is obligated to proceed with a transaction. Please confirm the parties’ full legal names and jurisdictions of organization.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE; NO COMMITMENT. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction (the “Purpose”) and may exchange Confidential Information. Neither party is required to disclose information or proceed with any transaction. No transaction obligation arises unless and until the parties execute a definitive written agreement.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY. “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of either party (the “Disclosing Party”) to the other (the “Receiving Party”) in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential, including analyses reflecting that information and the existence and status of discussions. Confidential Information excludes information the Receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes public without breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without a confidentiality duty; or (d) is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. The Receiving Party shall use Confidential Information only for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its personnel and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality duties at least as protective as those here, and shall be responsible for their breaches. If disclosure is legally required, the Receiving Party may disclose only the legally required portion and shall, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt prior notice and reasonably cooperate, at the Disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, except for copies required by law or professional retention obligations and routine backups not readily accessible in the ordinary course; retained information remains subject to this Agreement. No intellectual property rights are granted except the limited right to use information for the Purpose.

3. TERM; SURVIVAL. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months, unless either party terminates it earlier by written notice. Confidentiality and use restrictions survive expiration or termination for three years thereafter; for information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those restrictions continue for so long as it remains a trade secret.

4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages may be inadequate. The injured party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, subject to applicable law and judicial discretion, in addition to other available remedies.
